body:
Triage (finding round): promoted → `pm:queue`, type Task. First the count (how many ledgered packages carry a transitively-imported outside-`rootDir` file — invisible to include-glob scans, so it needs the re-measure itself), then the remedy sized to it; on the evidence here, always setting `compilerOptions.rootDir = pkgAbs` in the generated project looks principled (the docstring's own "measuring the tape measure" reasoning does not depend on how the file entered the program, and `--noEmit` protects no output layout) — but the dev should verify no ledger count *rises* under that change before choosing it. Each affected frozen entry becomes a `--lower` opportunity. Fold-or-serial pair with #10756 (same instrument file) — see the note there.
